matrix.description: One cell per ordered layer pair (a, b), a = 0..31 row, b = 0..31 column. Each cell holds a dynamic sphere on layer a and a static box on layer b, overlapping by 0.25 m. All cells sit in one world on a 3 m grid, so a cell can only contact its own partner. A pair interacts exactly when both masks accept each other's layer (§5.9).
matrix.maskRule: mask[i] = bit i, plus bit j for every j where (i*5 + j*3) % 7 < 2; then mask[0] = 0, mask[1] = 1 << 1, mask[31] = 0xffffffff. Recorded as data so the fixture does not depend on the formula.

recorded.notes: observedRows is one u32 per layer a; bit b is set when that cell produced a contact event. observedInteractions counts bits across the rows. Sensor and joint counts are events after the stated number of ticks; sensorBodyDeltaM is the largest change of the sensor-overlapped body's position and must be 0 for no contact response. All values are Node measurements from this fixture, not targets.
